build_dog_model: run build_dog.py to generate a MuJoCo dog.xml model from dog_base.xml with configurable spine DOFs
exclude_contacts: exclude self-collision contact pairs between adjacent body parts in the MJCF dog model
create_torso: build the dog torso, lumbar spine, and pelvis bodies with configurable degrees of freedom per vertebra
create_neck: build the dog cervical spine, skull, and jaw attached to the torso body
create_back_legs: build the dog hind legs with nails and sole sites attached to the pelvis body
